MOD = 1000000007
isVisited = [False] * 1010101

def explore(visited, v, base, modVal):
    if not visited[v]:
        visited[v] = True
        explore(visited, (v * base) % modVal, base, modVal)

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    result = 1
    if k == 1:
        result = p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not isVisited[i]:
            explore(isVisited, i, k, p)
            result = (result * p) % MOD
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
